units.characteristics: devastation as a summons to lament; the turn of the whole creature toward God
units.gist: the locust plague strips the land; 'gladness DRIES UP from the children of man'; the call to 'CONSECRATE A FAST... and CRY OUT to the LORD'; 'TO YOU, O LORD, I CALL... even the beasts of the field PANT FOR YOU' - loss stripping every comfort and driving the creature to cry to God

units.characteristics: the day of the LORD; inner repentance - rend the heart, not the garment
units.gist: THE GEM - the day of the LORD, the terrible army, 'who can endure it?'; then 'YET EVEN NOW, RETURN TO ME WITH ALL YOUR HEART, with fasting and weeping; and REND YOUR HEARTS AND NOT YOUR GARMENTS. Return to the LORD, for he is GRACIOUS AND MERCIFUL, slow to anger, abounding in steadfast love, and he RELENTS over disaster' - the turn of the whole heart vs the torn robe

units.characteristics: the years restored; satisfied and unashamed; the Spirit poured on all flesh
units.gist: GEM - God's answer: 'FEAR NOT... be glad and rejoice'; 'I will RESTORE TO YOU THE YEARS that the swarming locust has eaten'; 'you shall eat in plenty and be SATISFIED... my people shall never again be put to shame'; 'I will POUR OUT MY SPIRIT ON ALL FLESH... everyone who CALLS ON THE NAME of the LORD shall be saved'

units.characteristics: the nations judged; the valley of decision; the LORD a refuge to his people
units.gist: the nations gathered for judgment in the Valley of Jehoshaphat; 'multitudes, multitudes, in the VALLEY OF DECISION! for the day of the LORD is near'; 'the LORD roars from Zion... the heavens and earth quake, BUT THE LORD IS A REFUGE to his people, a STRONGHOLD to Israel' - the same day that terrifies the nations is refuge for his own
